actions.description: Remove the existing single-host servers array (https://app.posthog.com), which points at the deprecated app.posthog.com host and offers no region choice.
Add a region-templated server so the API can route to either PostHog Cloud region. The `region` server variable enumerates the EU and US hosts (eu.posthog.com / us.posthog.com) and defaults to eu.

servers.description: PostHog Cloud. Choose the region matching your project: EU (eu.posthog.com) or US (us.posthog.com).

region.description: PostHog Cloud region host prefix. `eu` -> eu.posthog.com (EU Cloud), `us` -> us.posthog.com (US Cloud).
